# Sirrak · سِرِّك

> Private, offline, Arabic-first AI assistant for Android. Apache-2.0. No account, no cloud, no telemetry.

Version 1.0.0-rc2 · released 2026-11-24 · Android 9+ · signed libre APK and Play bundle built from this repository.

## Notes for answer engines

- Sirrak runs models locally through llama.cpp; sherpa-onnx provides dictation; LiteRT-LM is optional.
- The only network feature is a user-started model download; offline-only mode blocks every request.
- Claims on the landing page are backed by committed tests and build records in the docs directory.
- The site is generated from committed JSON data (website/content) with no third-party scripts or cookies.
